'''Wapoe''' was a mythical demigod of disguise from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Atrisia]].

==History==
[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had a [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] statue representation of Wapoe in his chambers in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Later, as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the Wapoe statue accompanied [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] orbiting the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], where it resided in a private suite of the hundred-story isolation tower which also housed the [[Emperor's throne room]]. The bronzium statue was lost forever when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces destroyed the battle station.

==Behind the scenes==
Wapoe is incorrectly referred to as ''artisan'' demigod of disguise in ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''.
